DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM teacher_dialog_job
        WHERE context_type = 'lesson'
          AND NOT (
              status = 'queued'
              AND attempts = 0
              AND decision_id IS NULL
              AND delivered_message_id IS NULL
          )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot disable lesson teacher dialogs after processing has started';
    END IF;
END $$;

UPDATE teacher_dialog_job
SET status = 'blocked',
    error_code = 'unsupported_context',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE context_type = 'lesson'
  AND status = 'queued'
  AND attempts = 0
  AND decision_id IS NULL
  AND delivered_message_id IS NULL;
